summary: Instruct policy to explicitly verify output files before declaring task completion

edits.hypothesis: Adding an explicit verification instruction for final output files in the prompt template prevents premature task completion when intermediate steps succeed but final artifacts are omitted.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose instructions in the template are the correct lever to guide policy completion behavior.
edits.retroactive_check: Corrective: bn-fit-modify would have verified output files and avoided omitting the final sample file. Preservative: iterative artifact generation habits remain intact. Transfer: generalizes to all tasks requiring output file deliverables.
edits.mechanism: Adding an explicit verification instruction for final output files in the prompt template prevents premature task completion when intermediate steps succeed but final artifacts are omitted.
